channel.title: nexusEVnews
channel.description: Independent EV and renewable energy news, curated daily. Electric vehicles, solar, battery tech, and charging infrastructure.

item.title: The Chinese EV Talk the US Keeps Avoiding
item.dc:creator: Kim Java
item.description: Kim Java, CleanTechnica's Larry Evans, and Rich Rebuilds on why the US market keeps shutting out the affordable Chinese EVs the rest of the world already buys.

item.title: The Geely EX2 Won a Skeptic Over
item.dc:creator: Electrifying
item.description: Electrifying's Nicola Hume reviews the Geely EX2, a cheap Chinese city EV headed to Europe with 214 miles of range and an 8-year, 125,000-mile warranty.

item.title: VW's ID Cross Goes After the Cheap Electric SUV
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Autogefühl's Thomas details the production VW ID Cross: a 4.15m electric SUV, over 400km WLTP, a 475-litre boot, real buttons, and pricing from about 28,000 euros.

item.title: The Audi RS e-tron GT Is Now a Used Bargain
item.dc:creator: Gjeebs
item.description: Gjeebs on the depreciated Audi RS e-tron GT: near $147,000 new, now roughly $100,000 less used, with an 8-year battery warranty and the quirks of a used German GT.

item.title: GM Dealers Are Discounting Electric Trucks Hard
item.dc:creator: The Electric Viking
item.description: The Electric Viking on GM's slow-selling electric pickups: Silverado EV sales down 32.5 percent and dealer discounts up to $21,400, bringing entry pricing near $53,950.

item.title: Rivian's Founder Lays Out the Bet Beyond Building Cars
item.dc:creator: Behind the Business
item.description: RJ Scaringe on the R2 volume play, an in-house AI inference chip, a $5.8B Volkswagen software deal, robotics, and why he thinks self-driving matters more than electrification.

item.title: The $8,000 Solarky sunV Is a Solar EV Built for Hot Cities
item.dc:creator: Everything Electric APAC
item.description: Everything Electric APAC drives a light 660 kg solar EV with an extending roof panel around Bangkok. Tiny battery, big idea for short trips in a hot climate.

item.title: The Rivian R2 Can Melt Older Charging Adapters
item.dc:creator: State of Charge
item.description: State of Charge had a pin melt on an older Tesla-branded adapter while fast charging an R2 at over 600 amps, and explains what to buy instead.

item.title: BMW iX3 Hits 400 kW on a V4 Supercharger, but Runs Hot
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Roaming
item.description: Out of Spec Roaming charges the 800V iX3 on a 1,000V-capable Tesla V4 Supercharger in Norway, hits 400 kW, and logs a battery that touches 59C.

item.title: Toyota bZ vs bZ4X: Cheaper, and a Lot Better
item.dc:creator: Ever
item.description: Ever compares the outgoing bZ4X with the 2026 bZ: more range, faster charging, a native NACS port, and a lower starting price.

item.title: Out of Spec Gets the First US Cayenne EV and Heads for the Dirt
item.dc:creator: Out of Spec Reviews
item.description: The base Cayenne Electric was flown in from Germany. Out of Spec launches it, takes it off road, and lands near $122,000 with a smaller battery than several rivals and no lane centering on early US cars.

item.title: How Chinese EVs Took Nearly a Third of the UK Market in Seven Years
item.dc:creator: CNBC
item.description: From under 1% to more than 30% in seven years. CNBC credits technology and a big price gap, but the UK's decision to skip tariffs is doing quiet work too.

item.title: Could You Live Full Time in an Electric VW Camper Van?
item.dc:creator: The Endless Adventure
item.description: Lovely hardware, tiny space, and a 234 mile rating that runs the trip. Three days in a camper converted ID Buzz says weekend yes, full time maybe a week.

item.title: Polestar and Lucid Are Slashing Prices, for Very Different Reasons
item.dc:creator: This Car Pod
item.description: Polestar is clearing stock before a 2027 US ban. Lucid is stacking 0% financing on the Gravity. One is regulation, one is soft demand, and both end at a lower sticker.

item.title: The Subaru Uncharted GT Missed Its Range Rating, but Not by Much
item.dc:creator: State of Charge
item.description: 255 miles at a true 70 mph against a 273 mile combined rating, about 18 short. The GT is the wrong trim to judge the car by, and 150 kW charging is the real asterisk.

item.title: XPENG's L03 Lands in Europe Undercutting VW's Smallest EVs
item.dc:creator: Autogefühl
item.description: Just under 36,000 euros for a 4.65 metre crossover with around 450 km of claimed range, ventilated seats and Google Maps built in. Autogefühl thinks the price is most of the argument.

item.title: The Self-Driving Story Nobody Is Telling
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The autonomy debate is all horse race. But for millions of people who cannot drive, a car that drives itself is the keys, handed back. Why Rivian's road to Level 4 matters more than the spec sheet, and the one thing it still has to get right.

item.title: We Built the Tracker We Wish Existed When We Were Waiting for Our R1s
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: People were reading website source code to find out when their Rivian was coming. Forum signatures listed Guide contact dates like military service records. We are not doing that again for the R2. The Rivian R2 Delivery Tracker is live.

item.title: Two Batteries, One Hitch, and the Case for All-Electric Glamping
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: The Lightship AE1 carries its own 69 kWh battery and 80 kW motor to neutralize trailer drag on the tow vehicle. Paired with a Rivian, the real-world efficiency numbers are hard to argue with. This is what all-electric glamping looks like when the hardware actually works.

item.title: Atlanta, Rivian, and the Quiet Coincidence
item.dc:creator: Jacob Hunka
item.description: Atlanta has a failing air quality grade and a Rivian plant on its doorstep. A hypothetical about what one city could do with the electric mobility infrastructure that already exists — R2 autonomous taxis, ALSO cargo quads, e-bikes, and ZTL-style restricted zones — and what the health data says the stakes actually are. Includes data from the HEI lockdown air quality study (Chen et al., 2025) and the American Lung Association's 2025 Atlanta air quality report.
